question: How do knowability-born divisions make fourteen?
premises: The instrument part of sakala is vidya-kala-natured.
inference: The seven knowability-born divisions combine with prior divisions to make fourteen.
uncertainties: The arithmetic relation to verse 7 is inferred.
plain_english: Knowability-born seven divisions; thus fourteen; of sakala, the instrument part which is vidya-kala-natured.
